account: Birmingham reports that its Foundry tools automate redaction, mailbox indexing, administrative work, and simple translation. Redaction reportedly takes 90 seconds instead of 10 minutes with 95% success. Mail indexing reportedly handles 55% of emails, saving 5,500 staff hours and £100,000 annually. The former £350,000 translation budget is not a demonstrated saving. The source also reports translation limitations and guardrail difficulties. In their second report, dated 31 January 2025 and published on 31 March 2025, the government-appointed commissioners wrote that the Foundry signals early progress and that they support it. Their third report, dated 23 October 2025 and published on 1 December 2025, says that the council was still using the approach and is at an early stage. Neither report gives a measured result for the tools.
